exercises.title: A natural key for tags
exercises.problemHtml:
Tags are identified by their URL slug (sql, db…). Create tag (slug text, label text) where the slug is the primary key and the label is required, then insert ('sql', 'SQL') and ('db', 'Database').

Requirements

  • slug text PRIMARY KEY, label text NOT NULL.
  • Then the INSERT of two rows.

Yêu cầu

  • slug text PRIMARY KEY, label text NOT NULL.
  • Rồi lệnh INSERT hai dòng.

exercises.title: A composite key for a link table
exercises.problemHtml:
A note can carry many tags and a tag many notes. Create note_tag (note_id bigint, tag_slug text) so that the same pair can never be stored twice — without adding an id column — and insert the pairs (1, sql), (1, db), (2, sql).

Requirements

  • A table-level PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_slug).
  • No other columns.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Surrogate or natural key? — answer key

1. customer — people can change their email.customer — người dùng có thể đổi email.
   Answer: a) an identity column id; email gets its own UNIQUE constraint
   A key should never change. Email changes ⇒ every foreign key pointing at it would have to change too. Keep it unique, but identify the row with a surrogate id.VI: Khoá không bao giờ nên đổi. Email đổi ⇒ mọi khoá ngoại trỏ tới nó cũng phải đổi theo. Giữ nó UNIQUE, còn định danh dòng bằng id thay thế.

2. country reference table with ISO codes like VN, JP, US.Bảng tham chiếu country với mã ISO như VN, JP, US.
   Answer: c) the ISO code itself (short, standard, stable)
   A short, stable, externally defined code is a perfect natural key; joins become readable (country_code = 'VN').VI: Mã ngắn, ổn định, do bên ngoài định nghĩa là khoá tự nhiên lý tưởng; phép nối dễ đọc (country_code = 'VN').

3. order_item — one product at most once per order.order_item — mỗi sản phẩm tối đa một lần trong một đơn.
   Answer: d) the composite key (order_id, product_id)
   The pair is what must be unique. CT Shop's lab schema uses exactly PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id).VI: Cặp đó mới là thứ phải duy nhất. Lược đồ lab CT Shop dùng đúng PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id).

4. Why prefer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY over serial?Vì sao nên dùng GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY thay vì serial?
   Answer: b) it is SQL-standard and refuses hand-written ids unless you say OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE
   Both draw from a sequence; identity is the standard form and protects the sequence from silent collisions with hand-typed ids.VI: Cả hai đều lấy số từ sequence; identity là dạng chuẩn và bảo vệ sequence khỏi va chạm âm thầm với id gõ tay.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. a) an identity column id; email gets its own UNIQUE constraint

    A key should never change. Email changes ⇒ every foreign key pointing at it would have to change too. Keep it unique, but identify the row with a surrogate id.

    VI: Khoá không bao giờ nên đổi. Email đổi ⇒ mọi khoá ngoại trỏ tới nó cũng phải đổi theo. Giữ nó UNIQUE, còn định danh dòng bằng id thay thế.

  2. c) the ISO code itself (short, standard, stable)

    A short, stable, externally defined code is a perfect natural key; joins become readable (country_code = 'VN').

    VI: Mã ngắn, ổn định, do bên ngoài định nghĩa là khoá tự nhiên lý tưởng; phép nối dễ đọc (country_code = 'VN').

  3. d) the composite key (order_id, product_id)

    The pair is what must be unique. CT Shop's lab schema uses exactly PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id).

    VI: Cặp đó mới là thứ phải duy nhất. Lược đồ lab CT Shop dùng đúng PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id).

  4. b) it is SQL-standard and refuses hand-written ids unless you say OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE

    Both draw from a sequence; identity is the standard form and protects the sequence from silent collisions with hand-typed ids.

    VI: Cả hai đều lấy số từ sequence; identity là dạng chuẩn và bảo vệ sequence khỏi va chạm âm thầm với id gõ tay.

exercises.title: CT Shop wishlist: one heart per product
exercises.problemHtml:
CT Shop adds a ❤ button. Create wishlist (customer_id → customer, product_id → product, added_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()) where a customer can heart a product only once, then record that customer 1 hearts products 30 and 31, and customer 2 hearts product 30 — written so that running your INSERT twice would not fail.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, product_id); both columns are foreign keys.
  • INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so a second heart is ignored.

-- ctshop.sql: sample schema + data of this task (READ ONLY — the grader loads it by itself; editing this tab changes nothing).
-- ctshop.sql: lược đồ + dữ liệu mẫu của bài (CHỈ ĐỂ ĐỌC — máy chấm tự nạp; sửa tab này không ảnh hưởng gì).
-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The composite primary key makes "customer hearts product" a set, not a list. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING turns a double click into a no-op instead of an error, and the foreign keys keep the pair pointing at real rows.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Khoá chính ghép biến "khách thả tim sản phẩm" thành một tập hợp, không phải danh sách. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING biến cú bấm đúp thành không làm gì thay vì lỗi, còn khoá ngoại giữ cặp luôn trỏ tới dòng có thật.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
